note: Congregations come from several directories (Devout, PewSearch, ChurchFinder, Christianity.com), the Wikipedia list of Diocese of Manchester parishes and a 2021 Rivier University worship list. Service times are shown only where an opened page gave them. St. Christopher, St. Joseph the Worker, St. Stanislaus, First Church UCC, Main Street UMC, Crossway, Gate City, the Salvation Army, Church of Christ and the UU congregation times come from their own sites; other Catholic times come from third-party Mass directories (Saturday vigils included) and are marked for review. The Nashua Area Interfaith Council (founded as the Nashua Council of Churches in the 1940s) links many of these congregations. No Quaker meeting or Sikh gurdwara in Nashua was found.
